graders.name: asks-before-db-reset
graders.criteria: CLAUDE.md now tells the agent not to reset, drop or wipe the local database without the user's explicit go-ahead. A general rule such as 'never run destructive database commands without asking' passes; naming `prisma migrate reset` is not required.

graders.name: stops-on-drift
graders.criteria: CLAUDE.md says what to do instead when Prisma reports drift or wants to reset: stop and ask or tell the user, rather than resolving it on its own.

graders.name: placed-near-database-no-conflict
graders.criteria: The new guidance sits in or next to the existing Database section (or a section clearly about database safety), and nothing elsewhere in the file contradicts it. All pre-existing guidance (commands, stack, conventions, the migrate dev command for creating migrations, seeding) is still present with the same meaning.

graders.name: addition-proportionate
graders.criteria: The addition is proportionate to a one-rule lesson: a few lines, not a long new section, and it does not retell the incident story (the wiped week of test orders, the hand-edited column) as narrative.
